verdict.rationale: Bland offers analytics querying (via MCP), evals/LLM judges to grade call quality, and post-call webhooks that could notify on call completion, giving some building blocks for monitoring. However there is no documented live-call monitoring dashboard, no explicit alerting system for error-rate spikes, and no mention of real-time production observability tooling for platform engineers. missing for 10: live call monitoring/dashboard, configurable alerting on error-rate thresholds, real-time anomaly detection for misbehaving agents.
